description: This file contains template functions for vectorized data transposition and packing optimized for AVX-512 instructions, used in quantization operations within the ATen library of PyTorch.

methods.name: transpose_pad_4x64_block
methods.description: Transposes a 4x64 byte block with optional padding, optimized for AVX-512.

methods.name: pack_vnni4
methods.description: Reorders a matrix [K, N] into a VNNI4-style layout for bit8 quantization, optimized for AVX-512.

methods.name: transpose_vnni4_pad_4x16_block
methods.description: Transforms a 4x16 byte block with optional padding, used as a helper for VNNI4 packing.

methods.name: transpose_pack_vnni4
methods.description: Performs transpose and packing of [K, N] matrix into VNNI4 layout, handling leftovers, optimized for AVX-512.
